meta.title: Visa unlock dataset: base passport matrix + third-country visa/residence rules
meta.base_matrix_source: passport-index-dataset by ilyankou (GitHub, MIT licence), tidy ISO3 CSV, downloaded 2026-10-16. Values: number = visa-free days, 'visa free', 'eta', 'visa on arrival', 'e-visa', 'visa required', 'no admission', '-1' = own country.
meta.rules_source: Destination-by-destination sweep of Wikipedia 'Visa policy of X' pages, cross-checked against official or recent sources for the high-impact rules (see each rule's sources).
meta.accuracy_note: Side-project grade (target 90-95%). Rules change often; check the official source before travel. Airlines decide boarding using IATA Timatic.

document_types.visa: a visa issued by the issuer country
document_types.residence_permit: any residence permit, temporary or permanent (includes green cards/PR cards)
document_types.permanent_residence: permanent residence only (green card, PR card)

meta.nat_semantics: {'list': [...]} applies only to those passports. {'all': true, 'except': [...]} applies to any passport not listed; it only matters where it beats the base status.
meta.matching_logic: A held document (issuer ISO3, type) matches a rule doc spec if issuer is in the expanded issuer list (groups expanded) and the type is listed; a held permanent_residence also satisfies residence_permit. A rule upgrades passport P at destination D if P qualifies, a held document matches, the rule is active on the travel date, and the grant ranks above P's base status at D.
